sb_init.brief: 初始化一个小型字符串缓冲 / Initialise a small string builder

params.sb: inout:待初始化的字符串缓冲 / String builder to initialise

sb_init.note: 初始容量 256 字节，调用方随后须用 `sb_free` 释放 / Starts at 256 bytes; release it later with `sb_free`

sb_add.brief: 向字符串缓冲追加 n 字节 / Append n bytes to the string builder

params.n: in:追加的字节数 / Number of bytes to append

sb_add.note: 容量不足时反复翻倍并 realloc / Capacity is doubled (via realloc) until it fits

sb_free.brief: 释放字符串缓冲 / Free the string builder

params.sb: inout:待释放的字符串缓冲 / String builder to release

sb_free.note: 释放后把内部指针置 `NULL` / The internal pointer is set to `NULL`

node_value.brief: 把 DOM 节点包装成宿主值 / Wrap a DOM node in a host value

params.node: 要包装的节点 / Node to wrap

node_value.return: 包装该节点的 JsValue；`node` 为 `NULL` 时返回 `null` / A JsValue wrapping the node; `null` when `node` is `NULL`
node_value.note: DocumentFragment 用 fragment 虚表，其余用 element 虚表 / A fragment uses the fragment vtable, everything else the element vtable

arg_node.brief: 从实参解包出 DOM 节点 / Unwrap a DOM node from an argument

params.v: 待解包的 JS 值 / JS value to unwrap

arg_node.return: 节点指针（element 或 fragment 宿主），否则 `NULL` / The node pointer (element or fragment host), or `NULL`

hpe_js_dom_node_value.brief: node_value 的公开包装，供 MutationObserver 复用 / Public wrapper over node_value, reused by the MutationObserver bridge

params.node: 要包装的节点 / Node to wrap

hpe_js_dom_node_value.return: 包装该节点的 JsValue；`node` 为 `NULL` 时返回 `null` / A JsValue wrapping the node; `null` when `node` is `NULL`

arg_string.brief: 取第 idx 个实参并转成字符串 / Convert the idx-th argument to a string
arg_string.return: 新分配的字符串；下标越界时返回 `NULL` / Newly allocated string, or `NULL` when the index is out of range

css_name_from_js.brief: 把 camelCase 的 JS 属性名转成连字符小写的 CSS 名 / Convert a camelCase JS property name to a dashed lowercase CSS name

params.jsname: JS 侧属性名 / Property name on the JS side

css_name_from_js.note: 每个大写字母展开为 `-` 加小写；输出始终以 NUL 结尾 / Each uppercase letter becomes `-` plus its lowercase; the output is NUL-terminated

collect_text.brief: 递归收集子树中的文本 / Recursively collect the text of a subtree

params.node: 子树根节点 / Subtree root node

collect_text.note: 只拼接文本节点，仅对元素节点递归 / Only text nodes are appended, and only elements are recursed

serialize_node.brief: 把节点序列化成 HTML 文本 / Serialise a node as HTML text
serialize_node.note: 文本节点原样输出；元素输出开始/结束标签与全部属性（属性值不转义）/ Text nodes are emitted verbatim; elements emit their open/close tags and every attribute (values are not escaped)

element_get_text.brief: 取元素的 textContent / Read an element's `textContent`
element_get_text.return: 子树文本拼接成的 JS 字符串 / A JS string holding the concatenated subtree text

element_get_html.brief: 取元素子树的 innerHTML / Read an element's `innerHTML`
element_get_html.return: 子节点序列化后的 JS 字符串 / A JS string holding the serialised child nodes
element_get_html.note: 不含元素自身的标签 / The element's own tag is not included

node_replace_children_with_text.brief: 删除全部子节点并追加一个文本节点 / Replace every child with a single text node

params.text: 新文本；`NULL` 按空串处理 / New text; `NULL` is treated as empty

node_replace_children_with_text.note: 逐个 detach 子节点，使 MutationObserver 与引擎脏标记能看到删除 / Children are detached one by one so the mutation sink sees the removals

node_set_inner_html.brief: 解析 HTML 片段并替换元素的子节点 / Parse an HTML fragment and replace the element's children

params.html: HTML 文本；`NULL` 按空串处理 / HTML text; `NULL` is treated as empty

node_set_inner_html.note: 先清空原有子节点，再把解析结果体节点的子节点搬入 / Existing children are cleared first, then the parsed body's children are moved in

collect_elements.brief: 按文档顺序收集子树中的元素 / Collect the elements of a subtree in document order

params.out: 可增长的元素数组 / Growable element array
params.cap: inout:数组当前容量 / Current array capacity
params.count: in:已收集的元素个数 / Number of elements already collected

collect_elements.return: 收集到的元素总数 / Total number of elements collected
collect_elements.note: 不含 `node` 自身；数组按需倍增 / `node` itself is excluded; the array doubles on demand

query_selector_impl.brief: querySelector/querySelectorAll 的共用实现 / Shared implementation of querySelector and querySelectorAll

params.all: 非 0 时返回全部匹配 / Non-zero to return every match

query_selector_impl.return: `all` 非 0 时返回匹配元素数组，否则返回首个匹配元素或 `null` / An array of matches when `all` is set, else the first match or `null`
query_selector_impl.note: 选择器为空时：`all` 返回空数组，否则返回 `null` / On an empty selector: an empty array when `all`, otherwise `null`

dom_find_by_id.brief: 广度优先查找指定 id 的首个元素 / Breadth-first search for the first element with the given id
dom_find_by_id.return: 匹配的元素，未找到时返回 `NULL` / The matching element, or `NULL` when none is found

dm_get_element_by_id.return: 找到的元素宿主值，否则 `null` / The element host value, else `null`

dm_create_element.return: 新元素的宿主值；标签为空时返回 `null` / Host value of the new element, or `null` for an empty tag

dm_create_element_ns.return: 新元素的宿主值；标签为空时返回 `null` / Host value of the new element, or `null` for an empty tag
dm_create_element_ns.note: 命名空间被忽略，只取标签名（SVG 子元素按标签绘制）/ The namespace is ignored; only the tag name matters (SVG children are drawn by tag name)

dm_create_fragment.return: 新文档片段的宿主值 / Host value of the new document fragment

dm_remove_child.note: 仅当子节点确属该父节点时才 detach / The child is detached only when it really belongs to this parent

dm_clone_node.return: 克隆出的节点宿主值 / Host value of the cloned node

params.js: JS 运行时上下文 / JS runtime context

dm_has_child_nodes.return: 存在子节点返回 `true`，否则 `false` / `true` when a child exists, otherwise `false`

dm_insert_before.return: 插入的子节点宿主值；子节点为空时返回 `null` / Host value of the inserted child, or `null` when the child is absent

dm_replace_child.return: 被替换掉的旧节点宿主值；旧节点为空时返回 `null` / Host value of the replaced old node, or `null` when it is absent

dm_get_attribute.return: 属性值字符串，不存在时返回 `null` / The attribute value string, or `null` when absent

dm_set_attribute.note: 属性值缺失时写入空串 / An absent value is stored as the empty string

dm_has_attribute.return: 属性存在返回 `true`，否则 `false` / `true` when the attribute exists, otherwise `false`

dm_append_child.return: 追加的子节点宿主值；子节点为空时返回 `null` / Host value of the appended child, or `null` when the child is absent

dm_remove_self.brief: `remove` 的实现：把自己从父节点上摘除 / Implementation of `remove`: detach this node from its parent

dm_query_selector.return: 首个匹配元素的宿主值，无匹配或空选择器时返回 `null` / Host value of the first match, or `null` when nothing matches or the selector is empty

dm_query_selector_all.return: 匹配元素组成的数组 / An array of the matching elements

dm_add_event_listener.note: 事件类型为空时不注册 / Nothing is registered for an empty event type

dom_method_dispatch.brief: DOM 方法绑定对象的统一入口 / Common entry point for bound DOM method objects

params.thisv: 调用时的 this（未使用）/ The `this` value (unused)
params.ud: 指向 DomMth 的绑定信息 / Binding info pointing at the `DomMth`

dom_method_dispatch.return: 查表命中的方法返回值；未命中时返回 `undefined` / The matched method's result, or `undefined` when the name is unknown
dom_method_dispatch.note: 纯查表分派，新增方法只需在表中加一行 / Dispatch is a pure table lookup, so adding a method is a one-line table edit

bind_dom_method.brief: 把某个 DOM 方法绑定成原生函数对象 / Bind one DOM method as a native function object
bind_dom_method.return: 绑定到该节点的方法函数值 / A function value bound to this node
bind_dom_method.note: 绑定信息从 js arena 分配 / The binding info is allocated from the JS arena

method_is.brief: 判断属性名是否是受支持的 DOM 方法 / Test whether a property name is a supported DOM method
method_is.return: 是方法名返回 1，否则 0 / 1 when it is a method name, otherwise 0

on_prop_event.brief: 把 `on*` 属性名映射成事件类型名 / Map an `on*` property name to its event type name
on_prop_event.return: 对应的事件类型串（如 `click`）；否则 `NULL` / The matching event type (e.g. `click`), or `NULL`
on_prop_event.note: 当前支持 `onclick` / `onmousedown` / `onmouseup` / Currently recognises `onclick`, `onmousedown` and `onmouseup`

node_listeners.brief: 取节点上的监听器链表头 / Get the head of a node's listener list
node_listeners.return: 监听器链表头，可能为 `NULL` / The listener list head, possibly `NULL`

listener_append.brief: 在节点上登记一个事件监听器 / Store an event listener on a node

params.via_on: 经 `on*` 属性登记为 1 / 1 when added through an `on*` property

listener_append.note: `via_on` 会替换同类型的旧监听；handler 为 `null`/`undefined` 时只做删除 / A `via_on` handler replaces any previous one of the same type; a `null`/`undefined` handler only removes

on_handler_get.brief: 取某类型经 `on*` 登记的监听器 / Read the `on*` handler registered for a type
on_handler_get.return: 对应的处理函数；没有时返回 `null` / The handler function, or `null` when none is set

native_noop.brief: 什么都不做的原生函数 / A native function that does nothing
native_noop.note: 用作 `reload`/`scrollTo` 等空实现 / Used as the empty implementation for `reload`, `scrollTo` and friends

native_stop_propagation.brief: 在事件对象上记录停止传播标志 / Record a stop-propagation flag on the event object

params.thisv: 事件对象 / The event object

native_stop_propagation.note: `stopPropagation` 与 `stopImmediatePropagation` 共用此实现 / Both `stopPropagation` and `stopImmediatePropagation` share this implementation

propagation_stopped.brief: 检查事件对象是否已请求停止传播 / Test whether the event object asked to stop propagation
propagation_stopped.return: 已停止返回 1，否则 0 / 1 when stopped, otherwise 0

event_object.brief: 构造一个事件对象 / Build an event object

params.x: 客户端 X 坐标 / Client X coordinate
params.y: 客户端 Y 坐标 / Client Y coordinate
params.target: 事件目标节点 / Event target node

event_object.return: 带有 type/clientX/clientY/target 及方法的事件对象 / An event object carrying type/clientX/clientY/target plus methods
event_object.note: 同时挂上 `preventDefault`（空实现）与两个停止传播方法 / Also attaches `preventDefault` (a no-op) and the two stop-propagation methods

hpe_js_dom_dispatch.brief: 从目标节点向上冒泡派发事件 / Dispatch an event by bubbling from the target upwards

params.target: 事件目标节点 / Event target node

hpe_js_dom_dispatch.return: 至少调用过一个处理函数时返回 1，否则 0 / 1 when at least one handler ran, otherwise 0
hpe_js_dom_dispatch.note: 每层更新 `currentTarget`；处理函数调用 `stopPropagation` 后立即停止 / `currentTarget` is updated per level; dispatch stops as soon as a handler requests it

element_upper_tag.brief: 取元素标签名并转成大写 / Read an element's tag name uppercased
element_upper_tag.return: 大写标签名的 JS 字符串 / A JS string holding the uppercased tag name
element_upper_tag.note: 模拟 HTML 文档中浏览器报告大写元素名的行为 / Mimics how browsers uppercase element names in HTML documents

element_attr_str.brief: 取属性值，缺失时返回空串 / Read an attribute value, falling back to the empty string
element_attr_str.return: 属性值的 JS 字符串；缺失时为空串 / A JS string with the attribute value, or the empty string when absent

element_client_size.brief: 取元素的 clientWidth/clientHeight / Read an element's `clientWidth`/`clientHeight`
element_client_size.return: 布局后的内容区宽度或高度；无盒时返回 0 / The laid-out content width or height, or 0 without a box
element_client_size.note: 浏览器在此会强制布局；本引擎用元素到盒的反向指针取已布局尺寸 / Browsers force layout here; the engine reads the laid-out size via the element-to-box back pointer

eg_node_type.brief: `nodeType` 读取器，元素固定返回 1 / `nodeType` getter, always 1 for elements

eg_tag_name.return: 大写标签名的 JS 字符串 / A JS string with the uppercased tag name

eg_id.return: `id` 属性值的 JS 字符串 / A JS string with the `id` attribute

eg_class_name.return: `class` 属性值的 JS 字符串 / A JS string with the `class` attribute

eg_text_content.return: 子树文本拼接成的 JS 字符串 / A JS string holding the concatenated subtree text

eg_inner_html.return: 子节点序列化后的 JS 字符串 / A JS string holding the serialised children

eg_style.brief: `style` 读取器，返回样式宿主对象 / `style` getter, returning a style host object
eg_style.return: 绑定到该节点的 style 宿主值 / A style host value bound to this node

eg_first_child.return: 首个子节点的宿主值，没有时返回 `null` / Host value of the first child, or `null` when there is none

eg_next_sibling.return: 下一个兄弟节点的宿主值，没有时返回 `null` / Host value of the next sibling, or `null` when there is none

eg_parent_node.return: 父节点的宿主值，没有时返回 `null` / Host value of the parent, or `null` when there is none

eg_client_size.return: 布局后的内容区尺寸 / The laid-out content size

element_vt_get.brief: 元素宿主的属性读取虚函数 / Property-get virtual for element hosts

params.target: in:元素宿主逐个的 DOM 节点指针 / DOM node behind the element host
params.out: out:接收读取结果的值 / Receives the read value

element_vt_get.return: 已处理返回 1，未识别返回 0 / 1 when handled, 0 when the property is unknown
element_vt_get.note: 顺序为 `<template>.content`、属性表、方法绑定、`on*` 处理函数 / Order: `<template>.content`, the property table, method binding, then `on*` handlers

element_vt_set.brief: 元素宿主的属性写入虚函数 / Property-set virtual for element hosts

params.target: in:元素宿主背后的 DOM 节点指针 / DOM node behind the element host
params.value: 待写入的值 / Value to write

element_vt_set.return: 已处理返回 1，未识别返回 0 / 1 when handled, 0 when the property is unknown
element_vt_set.note: 处理 `textContent`/`innerHTML`/`style`/`id`/`className` 与 `on*` 属性 / Handles `textContent`, `innerHTML`, `style`, `id`, `className` and `on*` properties

fragment_vt_get.brief: 文档片段宿主的属性读取虚函数 / Property-get virtual for document-fragment hosts

params.target: in:片段宿主背后的 DOM 节点指针 / DOM node behind the fragment host
params.out: out:接收读取结果的值 / Receives the read value

fragment_vt_get.return: 已处理返回 1，未识别返回 0 / 1 when handled, 0 when the property is unknown
fragment_vt_get.note: `nodeType` 为 11；`childNodes`/`children` 每次读取都构造一次快照 / `nodeType` is 11; `childNodes`/`children` build a snapshot on each read

fragment_vt_set.brief: 文档片段宿主的属性写入虚函数 / Property-set virtual for document-fragment hosts

params.target: in:片段宿主背后的 DOM 节点指针 / DOM node behind the fragment host
params.value: 待写入的值 / Value to write

fragment_vt_set.return: 已处理返回 1，未识别返回 0 / 1 when handled, 0 when the property is unknown
fragment_vt_set.note: 仅处理 `textContent` 与 `innerHTML` / Only `textContent` and `innerHTML` are handled

style_vt_get.brief: style 宿主的属性读取虚函数 / Property-get virtual for style hosts

params.target: in:样式宿主背后的 DOM 节点指针 / DOM node behind the style host
params.out: out:接收读取结果的值 / Receives the read value

style_vt_get.note: camelCase 属性名转成 CSS 名后查内联样式，缺失返回空串 / The camelCase name is converted to a CSS name and looked up in the inline style; absent values give the empty string

style_vt_set.brief: style 宿主的属性写入虚函数 / Property-set virtual for style hosts

params.target: in:样式宿主背后的 DOM 节点指针 / DOM node behind the style host
params.value: 待写入的值 / Value to write

style_vt_set.return: 节点为空返回 0，否则返回 1 / 0 when the node is absent, otherwise 1
style_vt_set.note: 写入内联样式表 / Writes into the inline style table

document_vt_get.brief: document 宿主的属性读取虚函数 / Property-get virtual for the document host

params.target: in:文档根节点指针 / Document root node
params.out: out:接收读取结果的值 / Receives the read value

document_vt_get.return: 已处理返回 1，未识别返回 0 / 1 when handled, 0 when the property is unknown
document_vt_get.note: `body`/`head`/`documentElement` 按标签查找；随后是方法绑定与 `on*` / `body`/`head`/`documentElement` are looked up by tag, followed by method binding and `on*`

document_vt_set.brief: document 宿主的属性写入虚函数 / Property-set virtual for the document host

params.target: in:文档根节点指针 / Document root node
params.value: 待写入的值 / Value to write

document_vt_set.return: 已处理返回 1，未识别返回 0 / 1 when handled, 0 when the property is unknown
document_vt_set.note: `title` 写入 head 中的 title 元素；`on*` 登记监听 / `title` writes into the title element within head; `on*` registers a listener

loc_toString.brief: `location.toString` 实现，返回 `href` / Implementation of `location.toString`, returning `href`
loc_toString.return: `href` 字段的字符串形式 / The `href` field as a string

dom_style_stub.brief: `getComputedStyle` 的空实现 / Empty implementation of `getComputedStyle`
dom_style_stub.return: 一个新的空对象 / A fresh empty object
dom_style_stub.note: 引擎不计算样式，仅让守卫代码不报错 / The engine does not compute styles; this only keeps guarding scripts from failing

dom_raf.brief: `requestAnimationFrame` 的空实现 / Empty implementation of `requestAnimationFrame`
dom_raf.note: 回调不会被调度 / The callback is never scheduled

set_prop.brief: 往对象上设置一个属性 / Set one property on an object
set_prop.note: `js_obj_set` 的薄封装 / A thin wrapper over `js_obj_set`

nat.brief: 把原生函数指针包成 JS 函数值 / Wrap a native function pointer as a JS function value

params.fn: 原生函数指针 / Native function pointer

nat.return: 包好的函数值 / The wrapped function value

install_window_builtins.brief: 注册 location/navigator/window 等浏览器全局对象 / Register browser globals such as `location`, `navigator` and `window`
install_window_builtins.note: 引擎无网络也无导航，所有网络类方法都是空实现；只让检测这些对象的页面脚本继续运行 / The engine has no network or navigation, so network-ish methods are no-ops; this only keeps scripts that probe them running

hpe_js_dom_install.brief: 安装 DOM 绑定、浏览器全局、定时器与 MutationObserver / Install the DOM bridge, browser globals, timers and the MutationObserver
hpe_js_dom_install.note: 把 `document` 注册为全局宿主，随后依次安装 window 内建、定时器与变更通知 / `document` is registered as a global host, then window builtins, timers and change notification are installed
